Minecraft, but every block I look at gets added to my inventory. Sounds completely overpowered… until I realize just how chaotic it can get.

In this Minecraft challenge, I can collect blocks simply by looking at them. I’ll use this strange ability to gather resources, get powerful items, and try to beat Minecraft.

Can I defeat the Ender Dragon with this completely broken ability?
